integrity: All formulas are supported by an analytical proof and reproducible finite checks; no claim of independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Applies to bridgeless cactus networks with single-edge outages only, all conductances strictly positive, linear conductance prices and post-outage endpoint resistance; no overlapping cycles, bridges or arbitrary all-pairs objective.
Potential equivalent unindexed optimization literature; independent external scientific audit not performed.
title: Capped square-root allocation for fault-tolerant electrical detours on cactus networks
